judge_notes: The supplied markdown contains only the main text (no methods/supplementary); several candidate evidence quotes (arena size, 60-min NIL, 6-min FST, 20-min HTR, handling, housing, light cycle) could not be verified against the provided text. Where all candidates agreed on the same specific value, it was accepted with medium confidence; otherwise items were scored not_reported with low confidence.

Three behavioural assays retained: Novelty Induced Locomotion, Forced Swim Test (pre-drug + 24 h post-PCA sessions merged as one assay with 2 recording days), and Head-Twitch Response (PCA in WT, PCA in SERT- vs GFP-expressing mice, and 5-MeO-DMT positive control merged as one assay per the 'same paradigm, different manipulation' rule).

Dropped all non-behavioural endpoints: Golgi-Cox spine density, ex vivo electrophysiology (sEPSCs), Sholl analysis in cultured neurons, live-cell imaging/colocalization, psychLight biosensor assays, radioligand binding, IP/IP1 accumulation, and BRET assays.
Dosing for 5-MeO-DMT could not be resolved (candidates reported 10 vs 50 mg/kg); doses_mg_per_kg left empty with low confidence. PCA 5 mg/kg ip is verbatim in the main text.

B1 corrected to score 0 (single measure) for all three assays: only locomotion (NIL), only immobility (FST), and only head-twitch counts (HTR) are reported; candidates who scored '2-3' provided no evidence of additional measures.

D5 for FST corrected to Yes (second FST was run 24 h after PCA), overriding one candidate's 'No'. D2 for NIL set to 15–60 min (60 min inclusive), overriding a candidate who scored 60 min as '61 min–6 h'. D2 for HTR set to 15–60 min (20 min), overriding a candidate who scored 20 min as '<15 min'.
